snippet.title: The Legend of Zelda Nes Remake - Trailer
snippet.description:
Support my future projects: https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/LloydEmpty

Hello, I'm LloydEmpty from France and a big Zelda fan.
This video showcases an old personal project made as a technical experiment.

This project is discontinued and no longer in development.

It was created using Unreal Engine, FMOD, Blender, and GIMP.
The goal was to practice building a Zelda-style engine and explore visuals, audio, and gameplay systems.

It’s not perfect, but it was a valuable learning experience.
There is no downloadable version.

Enjoy.

Composer: Alcibiade Minel
https://soundcloud.com/alcibiade-minel
